data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 摘要明确以harness为改进对象，用执行失败与恢复证据驱动修改，并保留改进版本供后续迭代继承。

scope_support.feedback_quote: It autonomously generates new rollouts, probes execution failures and recovery behaviors, and iteratively modifies the harness based on the resulting evidence.
scope_support.object_quote: VISTA, a meta-agent framework that transforms post-hoc rollout reflection into active self-exploration for embodied harness improvement.
scope_support.persistence_quote: Each iteration begins from a retained harness version and its execution evidence.
